model_route.fallback: Only a confirmed quota, rate-limit, throttling, or temporary model-unavailable error permits fallback; code or test failure never does.

allowed_repository_mutations: create additional pure v2 helper or deterministic fixture files only when mechanically required by the frozen contract
prohibited_repository_mutations: modify any Phase 1 experiment artifact, evaluator, audit, result, rejection, ledger row, or publication claim
modify the frozen v2 preregistration, effective contract, direction review, or revision incorporation
modify CURRENT_STATE.json, any ledger, progress log, decision log, authorization, lock, Git state, or portfolio
open any market-data repository, market file, current exchangeInfo response, external data source, or network endpoint
resolve, stat, inspect, open, list, hash, or read any January-June 2026 holdout path, file, footer, schema, metadata, row, or value
calculate a strategy return, aggregate performance metric, acceptance gate, or performance claim
run git add, commit, push, fetch, reset, checkout, or history rewrite

data_and_runtime_scope.test_scope: synthetic deterministic and committed fixed fixtures only

implementation_requirements: create a distinct v2 production path; do not modify or silently reuse the v1 evaluator as the v2 implementation

resolve and implement the exact frozen composite contract without changing the seven trials, their order, signals, parameters, costs, folds, seed, accounting, nineteen gates, or any other economic or statistical rule

derive each decision from one synchronized cross-asset information set cut off at the maximum full-lookback availability timestamp, then select the earliest exact synchronized execution vector strictly after that cutoff
implement the frozen base and delayed clocks as independent cash-initialized state machines with the exact C_s and C_(s+1) transition order
select the actual last canonical synchronized terminal vector in the half-open boundary; never reuse a penultimate or reconstructed vector
enforce strict half-open fold prefix isolation, lifecycle-scoped preapproval 2026 rejection, and the distinct postapproval exact twelve-entry latch without resolving a holdout path in this stage
implement all ordered fail-closed data, quarantine, execution, evaluation, post-run repair, and audit-status precedence

implement deterministic canonical traces for information cutoffs, scores, decisions, targets, exact vectors, fills, costs, returns, dispositions, and terminal cash without calculating a market return in this stage
implement corrected finite and degenerate DSR/PBO handling and the append-only named-slot multiplicity registry exactly as frozen

implement frozen representative selectors, exact/categorical comparisons, 1e-12 finite-float tolerances, NaN rejection, and a genuinely independent reconciliation oracle that does not import the production calculation path
name tests so every applicable frozen pre-economic obligation is mechanically discoverable and prove the v1 economics remain unchanged

parent_validation_after_call.implementation_repair_accounting: An initial implementation call does not consume a repair round. A repository change required after parent validation is IMPLEMENTATION_BLOCKED_PRE_RUN and consumes exactly one authorized pre-run repair round.
